blocks.text: A bar chart (or bar graph) is a graphical representation used to display categorical data with rectangular bars, where the length or height of each bar is proportional to the value it represents. Bar charts are used to compare quantities across distinct categories or groups. In biology, bar charts are valuable for showing data like the counts of different species, experimental groups, or measurement results from biological samples. The key characteristics of a bar chart are:

items: Categories are represented by the x-axis (horizontal axis).
Values or frequencies are represented by the y-axis (vertical axis).
Bars can be oriented vertically or horizontally.
